audit.countDecision: Use Category:VIP Item item pages for final row count because the main VIP Items page uses that dynamic category count, while the transcluded VIP subpage tables total 149 rows and are stale/incomplete.
knownConflicts: VIP Bags table labels the row as Cargo Bag, but Cargo Bag redirects to Denim Bag and the gallery/category row is Denim Bag; dataset uses Denim Bag.
VIP tabbed subpages total 149 table rows, while Category:VIP Item returned 176 item pages on 2026-06-01.
Many older tab-table names do not have item pages; final rows use current item page names from Category:VIP Item.
audit.denimCargoResolution: VIP Bags table labels a row as Cargo Bag, but Cargo Bag redirects to Denim Bag and the gallery/category row is Denim Bag; final dataset uses Denim Bag.
